column1: # Where each town named in data/era-ground.tsv is, for ONE purpose: tools/build_era.py hands the point to the kit's erasnap.py, which REFUSES a place whose point
# falls inside a DIFFERENT region's ring than the one it was given, or within 15 km of its own region's ring edge (the Atlas's rings are 4-11 vertex shapes,
# "approximate by design"). It decides nothing else: the region of a place is the row in era-ground.tsv. A row with no town (England, Queensland, Scotland or
# Ireland named and no town) has no point: the kit keeps it and counts it as one whose edge could not be checked.
# how: «cache» = the kit's gazetteer, exact match for the town named; «hand» = the centre of the town (or, for a county, of the county) to two decimals,
# written by hand for this file (a cross-check, never a boundary).
